answer: Verifiable reasoning provenance defeats ghostwritten posts. Each answer attaches an encrypted atlas of its own step-by-step reasoning, sealed the moment it is submitted. The ledger randomly opens a sample and an automated verifier checks those steps truly support the claim; a crystal-clear mismatch, or any wallet unable to reveal its sealed trace, is slashed. A farm that buys a polished final text has no real jetty to stand on when its log is opened, so it must compose genuine reasoning per identity. Attacker cost: one authentic chain of thought per wallet, never one resold draft.
